basic_info.description: This charming Victorian era single-family residence with Bay Bridge and Bay views offering classic architecture with 3 bedrooms and 1 bath up. Potential to add a second bath upstairs. Originally built in 1900, the home spans approximately 1,044+- square feet upstairs with a separate entrance studio in-law below not included in square footage. Garage parking. Nice yard completes this home. Easy access to freeway, shopping on San Bruno Ave and schools nearby. Sunny neighborhood!
